exposure: Elevation of both fasting and post-load glucose levels
cohort: 3206 pregnant women in Uganda who underwent oral glucose tolerance testing between 24 and 28 weeks of gestation.
finding: While both fasting and post-load hyperglycemia were associated with adverse pregnancy outcomes, fasting hyperglycemia alone was more strongly associated with an increased risk of Caesarean section.
mod_finding: Elevated fasting blood glucose (FBG) alone increased the risk of Caesarian section by 1.36-fold.
